description: 2 pages, 11pt body. Page 1: 14pt heading "Results", a paragraph that mentions Figure 1 mid-sentence, a drawn figure box with the 9pt caption "Figure 1. Recall by list length.", a paragraph, the 9pt caption "Table 1. Mean words recalled by list length and age group." and a 4x4 table of short numbers (9pt, each cell its own text run, right-aligned columns ending at x=180/260/340/420). Page 2: a figure box with a two-line 9pt caption "Figure 2. ..." (the second line is a continuation at the same small size) between two body paragraphs.
format: Per page: `lines` = expected buildLines(page).map(l => l.text) in reading order; `spoken` = text to speak with DEFAULT_FILTERS; `spokenReadEverything` = text to speak with READ_EVERYTHING; `skipped` = what DEFAULT_FILTERS drop. Spoken text joins lines with single spaces, de-hyphenates "-" + lowercase line starts, and is normalized (ligatures expanded, soft hyphens removed, NBSP/thin space -> space).
